title: Find 3 leaves of different shapes
proof: Three leaves with clearly different shapes, side by side or in one frame.

title: Touch actual grass. Yes, really.
proof: A hand touching real grass (not artificial turf, not a screen).

title: Find something red that grows
proof: A living red plant part: flower, berry, leaf, or fruit still on the plant.

title: Find a tree wider than your arms can reach
proof: A thick tree trunk, ideally with arms or a person for scale.

title: Find a flower smaller than your fingernail
proof: A very small flower, ideally next to a fingertip for scale.

title: Find moss growing somewhere unexpected
proof: Green moss on a wall, rock, roof, pavement, or tree.

title: Find a seed, pod, or pinecone
proof: A seed, seed pod, acorn, pinecone, or similar plant seed structure.

title: Find a plant growing out of a crack in concrete
proof: A plant or weed growing through pavement, a wall, or concrete.

title: Find a four-leaf clover
proof: A clover with four leaflets, clearly visible.

title: Spot a bird and photograph it
proof: A real bird visible in the photo, any distance.

title: Photograph two different kinds of bird
proof: Two birds of visibly different species in one photo.

title: Find a feather on the ground
proof: A single feather, outdoors.

title: Catch a bird mid-flight
proof: A bird with wings open, in the air.

title: Spot a bird's nest
proof: A bird nest in a tree, building, or bush.

title: Watch a sunset from somewhere high
proof: A sunset or sunrise sky, taken from a rooftop, hill, or upper floor.

title: Find a cloud shaped like an animal
proof: A sky with clouds. Lenient: the player's imagination counts.

title: Lie down and photograph straight up
proof: A photo pointing straight up at the sky, through trees or open sky.

title: Find the moon in daylight
proof: The moon visible in a daytime (blue or bright) sky.

title: Photograph your shadow when it's taller than you
proof: A long human shadow on the ground, outdoors.

title: Find a rainbow (sprinklers count)
proof: A visible rainbow in the sky or in water spray.

title: Find a star in the night sky
proof: A night sky with at least one visible star or planet.

title: Walk down a street you've never walked before
proof: An outdoor street or path scene.

title: Find a bench and sit on it for 5 minutes
proof: An outdoor bench, ideally with the view from it.

title: Climb outdoor stairs and photograph the top
proof: Outdoor stairs or the view from the top of them.

title: Find the oldest-looking door in your neighbourhood
proof: A weathered or old door, photographed outdoors.

title: Walk until you can't see your home
proof: An outdoor scene away from buildings that look residential-close; lenient.

title: Reach the highest point you can walk to
proof: A view from a hilltop, viewpoint, or high place outdoors.

title: Find a reflection of the sky in water
proof: Sky or clouds reflected in a puddle, lake, or pond.

title: Find water that's moving
proof: A stream, river, fountain, waves, or flowing water.

title: Find a puddle (jumping is optional)
proof: A puddle on the ground outdoors.

title: Find a waterfall, any size
proof: Water falling over an edge: natural waterfall, weir, or fountain cascade.

title: Find the roughest bark you can
proof: A close-up of rough tree bark.

title: Find a perfectly smooth stone
proof: A smooth stone or pebble, ideally in a hand.

title: Find a heart shape in nature
proof: A natural object (leaf, stone, cloud, puddle) roughly shaped like a heart.

title: Find a mushroom (look, don't eat)
proof: A mushroom or fungus growing outdoors.

title: Spot an insect going about its day
proof: A real insect, spider, snail, or bug outdoors.

title: Photograph a butterfly
proof: A butterfly or moth, real and outdoors.

title: Spot a dog out on a walk
proof: A dog outdoors. Don't photograph strangers' faces.

title: Eat a snack outside, no screens
proof: Food or a drink being enjoyed outdoors.

title: Go on a walk with a friend
proof: Two people's feet or shadows outdoors (faces not required).

title: Play any game in a park
proof: A ball, frisbee, kite, or game being played outdoors.
